## What problem does this solve?

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List relevant checks actually run and their results. Note anything not tested. For an interface change, add a screenshot when it helps explain the result.

## Data and dependencies

Mention any effect on saved PGNs, annotations, drafts, progress, backups or downloaded resources. Identify new dependencies or third-party assets and their licences.

## Notes for reviewers

Explain any tradeoff or known limitation that matters for this change. Mention substantial AI assistance when relevant to understanding the work or its validation.
